title: Category unread state and acknowledgement retry safety

behavior.categorySummary: The existing summary.byCategory projection labels category filters with unread counts; the selected feed unreadCount gates category-scoped read-all visibility while All categories keeps the summary total.
behavior.acknowledgementRetry: A failed unread-notification acknowledgement leaves the tenant-bound panel open and defers navigation so the user can retry; a successful retry acknowledges and opens the existing safe destination.
behavior.preserved: Tenant/role guards, muted-category behavior, read/unread actions, pagination, preferences, SSE reconnect, polling fallback, focus containment, scroll isolation and tenant-safe deep links remain unchanged.

localVerification.focusedBrowser: 5/5 notifications.spec.ts using owned Redis 6380 and existing Chrome
localVerification.verifierPortNote: The project Compose stack was stopped without deleting containers or volumes for the owned fixture run because its mail/API/web/Redis ports were occupied, then started again and health-checked.

limits: This increment changes only notification-center category unread presentation and acknowledgement retry behavior.
